Previous administrative or program coordination experience, preferably in an academic, healthcare, or professional setting.
Experience supporting academic, medical, fellowship, residency, or accreditation programs.
Strong organizational skills with experience managing calendars, scheduling meetings, coordinating events, and maintaining records.
Experience with recruitment, onboarding, travel arrangements, or event coordination.
Experience maintaining confidential files and program documentation.
Provide administrative and program coordination support for the NCC and Neuromuscular Medicine Fellowship Programs.
Maintain fellowship schedules, trainee files, program records, evaluations, recruitment materials, and accreditation documentation.
Coordinate meetings, interviews, educational activities, onboarding, and program events.
Track accreditation deadlines, required submissions, and compliance documentation.
Communicate with fellows and faculty and provide ongoing administrative support to ensure smooth program operations.
Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel; working knowledge of PowerPoint and creating reports.
Familiarity with Macintosh OS and multi-line phone systems.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including composing correspondence and communicating with multiple stakeholders.
Accurate data entry and filing skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
